solutions.title: Triple collinearity
solutions.strategy: For every pair, count all points whose area determinant with that pair is zero.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are O(n^2) pairs and each pair scans all n points.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only counters and coordinate differences are stored.

solutions.title: Anchor slope map
solutions.strategy: For each anchor point, normalize slopes to all later points and count equal slope keys.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each anchor compares against every other point once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The slope frequency map for one anchor can contain O(n) slopes.
